notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.6.7: point at it, get it fixed, check it again

• Feedback that gets fixed: comment on anything in a Work Item's preview, send your comments to a repair, and Vekrun checks the new revision against each comment at the same page and screen size. You confirm each fix on its own; partial success is kept, and a repair that changed nothing leaves your comment open with the attempt recorded.
• Honest checks: a capture of the page is shown as your call to make, never as a pass; your tests are shown separately ("they check behaviour, not how it looks"). A check of an older revision can't be confirmed: the thread asks you to check again.
• Safe delivery: while a repair of your feedback is running or waiting for you, the revision it replaces can't be delivered, and once the fixes land in a repair, the original says "Superseded by a repair" and points you to the version to deliver.
• Live Share comments wait for your OK before they reach an agent, and join your open comments in the same repair.
• Monitoring is a tab on the Board, beside List and Ticket Board; a phase that ran on stopped work shows a neutral mark, not a success tick.
• Back is in one place: the top-left of every page you open from another, saying where it goes. ⌘[ still works everywhere.
• Repairs are named after what you asked, alerts from another project say which project, and "Check the new revision" opens the repair's preview.
• Reliability: simultaneous repair requests make exactly one repair; an interrupted repair that recovery completes carries on instead of being marked failed; a stalled VM copy falls back within two minutes, and each VM step is timed in a diagnostic log (Vekrun's data folder → logs/vekrun.log, with secrets removed).
